ev.q: Seven of 32 (22%) animals with available postbooster serum samples failed to meet PSM requirements
Among 30 animals with available prebooster serum samples, 14 (47%) had titers <0.5 IU/mL
Serologic testing confirmed that 22% of 32 animals in this shipment from Azerbaijan were not adequately vaccinated
Among dogs vaccinated at clinic A, the risk for PSM protocol failure was 3.6 times as high
A multistate investigation was conducted to prevent secondary rabies cases

methods_quotes.q: Dogs and cats with a second titer result of ≥0.5 IU/mL and more than a twofold rise in titer compared to baseline
* Measured by rapid fluorescent focus inhibition test.
